answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a non-transferable admission relic: burned proof-of-work at join, then a fresh semantic challenge every epoch. At dawn of each epoch, unanswered personas earn nothing and lose standing after a few misses, while kin-linked clones share one jury seat. Spinning a fable farm of sockpuppets therefore costs repeated real compute per head without multiplying vote or grade power, so attackers pay linearly and gain no extra influence.
